subtitle: Lesson 59 · Data Types, Strings, Dates and Modern T-SQL

eyebrow: A reminder: CAST can fail hard
code:
-- Raises an error and stops the batch:
SELECT CAST('not a number' AS INT);
-- Msg 245: Conversion failed converting the varchar value
-- 'not a number' to data type int.
caption: Plain CAST/CONVERT are all-or-nothing.

eyebrow: TRY_CAST: NULL instead of an error
code:
SELECT TRY_CAST('not a number' AS INT) AS Attempt1,
       TRY_CAST('123' AS INT) AS Attempt2;
-- Attempt1: NULL (would have failed)
-- Attempt2: 123
caption: Same conversion attempt -- a graceful NULL on failure.
Same signature as CONVERT, including the style argument.

eyebrow: Finding values that don't survive a real conversion
code:
SELECT PhoneNumber,
  TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PhoneNumber,
    '-', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AS BIGINT) AS DigitsOnly
FROM Person.PersonPhone
WHERE TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PhoneNumber,
    '-', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AS BIGINT) IS NULL;
caption: Flags phone numbers that still won't convert after cleanup.
